entry.title: Most municipalities to co-ordinate the same environmental awareness walk simultaneously - 34 🇻🇳

media:group.media:title: Most municipalities to co-ordinate the same environmental awareness walk simultaneously - 34 🇻🇳
media:group.media:description:
Congratulations to Nhan Dan Newspaper for achieving the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for most municipalities to co-ordinate the same environmental awareness walk simultaneously - 34 🇻🇳
In its second year, the programme brought communities together at 34 main event locations across Vietnam, alongside local walks in more than 3,000 communes, wards and special zones.
Together, participants championed walking as a daily habit to help reduce CO₂ emissions and inspire action towards a zero-waste future. The campaign was jointly organised by Nhan Dan Newspaper, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security and the Ho Chi Minh Communist Youth Union Central Committee.
Special thanks to Vietcombank, Petrolimex, TH Group and Vietnamobile for their valuable support in making this nationwide campaign a success.

entry.title: Folding a piece of paper TWELVE times 📄

media:group.media:title: Folding a piece of paper TWELVE times 📄
media:group.media:description:
It was an accepted belief that folding a piece of paper in half more than 8 times was impossible. On 27 January 2002, high school student, Britney Gallivan, of Pomona, California, USA, folded a single piece of paper in half 12 times and was the first person to fold a single piece paper in half 9, 10, 11, and 12 times. The tissue paper used was 4,000 ft (1,219 m; 0.75 miles) long.

media:group.media:title: World's LARGEST Polly Pockets collection 🤩
media:group.media:description:
The largest collection of Polly Pocket items is 534, achieved by Kerchie in California, USA on February 19, 2025, earning herself a Guinness World Records title.
Kerchie loved Polly Pocket as a child but gave away her collection when she grew older. In 2019, she started collecting again, beginning with a pink Jewel Magic Ball. She says she’s always loved the idea of a tiny world you can shrink into, a magical fantasy land of your own. Kerchie didn't only achieve this, she also became Officially Amazing.
